descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced Senior Vue.js Developer with strong frontend development skills and professional proficiency in French. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications while collaborating with international teams and stakeholders.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain responsive and user-friendly web applications using Vue.js.
Build reusable components and frontend modules following best practices and clean code principles.
Collaborate with backend developers, UX/UI designers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Translate business requirements and technical specifications into efficient frontend implementations.
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues and bugs.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural and technical decisions.
Ensure code quality through automated testing and continuous improvement.
Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with international teams.
 RequirementsProfessional Experience 
5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
Strong hands-on experience with Vue.js (Vue 2 and/or Vue 3).
Solid understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
Experience with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
Good knowledge of state management solutions such as Pinia or Vuex.
Experience integrating REST APIs and working with asynchronous data.
Familiarity with Git and modern frontend development workflows.
Experience with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, or Cypress.
 Language Requirements 
Professional proficiency in French (B2/C1 or higher).
Good command of English for technical communication and collaboration.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Nuxt.js.
Knowledge of modern build tools such as Vite and Webpack.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments.
Experience with UI component libraries such as Vuetify, PrimeVue, or Element Plus.
Understanding of microfrontend architecture.
 Soft Skills 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical tasks.
Attention to detail and commitment to code quality.
Proactive mindset and willingness to share knowledge with team members.
